class.name: NNBTRoot
class.brief_description: Root node that owns and ticks a behaviour tree.
class.description: Entry point for a behaviour tree. Give it a single enabled behaviour tree child (typically a composite or decorator) plus any optional [NNSensors] children used by [NNBTScoreBasedPicker] branches. By default the root ticks automatically on physics frames according to [member process_thread] and [member tick_rate]. Set [member process_thread] to [constant MANUAL] to drive ticks yourself with [method tick], or nest the root under a state, agent action, [NNBTRunHostedRoot], or HTN task to let that host drive it. Provides the [NNBlackboard] and actor context for all nodes in the tree, and emits [signal finished] whenever a run ends with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].

constants.constant: Ticks automatically on physics frames. This is the default.
Disables automatic ticking so your own code can call [method tick] or [method auto_tick_step].

method.name: auto_tick_step
method.description: Runs one scheduled step using the same enabled checks and [member tick_rate] throttle as automatic ticking. Returns [code]true[/code] if the tree ticked. Useful for custom schedulers and deterministic tests.

method.name: get_elapsed_time
method.description: Returns the total tick [code]delta[/code] accumulated since this root was created, in seconds. Used by time-based nodes such as [NNBTCooldown] so timers pause when the tree is not ticking.

method.name: get_running_action
method.description: Returns the deepest node currently in the [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] state after the last tick, or [code]null[/code] if no node is running.

method.name: tick
method.description: Updates child sensors and ticks the tree's child with [param delta], returning its [enum NNBTNodes.Status]. Use this in [constant MANUAL] mode or whenever you want to drive the tree directly.

members.member: Optional actor [Node] this tree acts for. When unset, [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] inherits from the nearest ancestor root or falls back to this node's parent.
Optional [NNBlackboard] resource for this tree. When unset, inherits from the nearest ancestor root or creates a private blackboard automatically.
Controls when the tree ticks automatically ([constant PHYSICS], [constant IDLE], or [constant MANUAL]). Ignored when hosted under another AI node.
Ticks every [code]N[/code]th frame (default [code]1[/code], every frame), passing the accumulated delta since the previous tick. Ignored when hosted under another AI node.
Duration in microseconds of the last [method tick] call (debug builds only).

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when a run completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] ([param succeeded] is [code]true[/code]) or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] ([code]false[/code]).

signal.name: tree_disabled
signal.description: Emitted when [member NoodleNodes.is_enabled] changes from [code]true[/code] to [code]false[/code].

signal.name: tree_enabled
signal.description: Emitted when [member NoodleNodes.is_enabled] changes from [code]false[/code] to [code]true[/code].
